ideas.pitch: A standalone analytics dashboard to track coding contest performance, parse submission errors, and suggest targeted algorithm practice.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar: Competitive programming contest featuring algorithmic problems ranging from basic data structures to advanced algorithms.
ideas.title: CP-Analyzer: Automated Competitive Programming Performance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the exact target audience of the contest by providing deep post-contest performance diagnostics which appeals directly to competitive programming organizers and participants.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web utility to visually step through common data structures and algorithmic patterns used in competitive programming.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar: Test algorithmic thinking and problem-solving speed with problems ranging from basic data structures to advanced algorithms.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer Pro: Real-Time Algorithm Step Execution Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a modular software architecture and working live demo pattern, making it immediately useful for learners preparing for algorithm-heavy rounds.

ideas.pitch: A local-first, low-latency template and snippet manager tailored for competitive programmers to quickly pull boilerplate data structures during contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar: Test algorithmic thinking, problem-solving speed, and coding proficiency under strict time constraints.
ideas.title: SnippetVault: Fast Competitive Programming Code Template Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a tangible speed bottleneck for solo participants facing strict time limits in a 135-minute contest format.

ideas.pitch: A CLI tool that locally benchmarks Python and C++ solutions against custom test case files to estimate time and space complexity before submission.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar: Problems evaluated automatically against hidden test cases with standard competitive programming scoring.
ideas.title: ComplexityTracker: Online Judge Memory and Time Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the evaluation criteria of automated grading by helping solo developers avoid TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) errors.

ideas.pitch: A minimalist time-management overlay specifically designed for 135-minute individual contests to allocate minutes per problem dynamically.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar: Duration: 135 minutes (2 hours 15 minutes) with 4 to 6 coding problems of varying difficulty levels.
ideas.title: ContestTimer & Strategy Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific time-constraint constraint of the contest structure with a focused, highly polished utility application.
